options.text: Tenant add-ons for an existing Sentinel workspace: Entra ID logs and Azure Activity for a management group. Deploy the core template first. The person deploying needs Owner at the tenant root ("/") and, for Entra logs, Global or Security Administrator. A Global Administrator can enable 'Access management for Azure resources' in Entra properties and grant themselves Owner at "/" for the deployment.

elements.name: resourceGroupName
elements.label: Resource group of the Sentinel workspace

options.text: Creates a tenant-level diagnostic setting sending the chosen Entra logs to the workspace. Sign-in logs need Entra ID P1 or P2.

elements.name: enableEntraSignInLogs
elements.label: Sign-in logs (interactive, non-interactive, service principal, managed identity)

elements.name: enableEntraRiskLogs
elements.label: Identity Protection risk logs (risky users, risk events)

elements.name: enableActivityPolicy
elements.label: Azure Activity for all subscriptions under a management group (policy)

elements.name: managementGroupId
elements.label: Management group ID
elements.visible: [or(steps('activity').enableActivityPolicy, or(steps('activity').enableKeyVaultLogs, steps('activity').enableNsgLogs, steps('activity').enableFirewallLogs, steps('activity').enableAppGatewayLogs, steps('activity').enableAksLogs, steps('activity').enableAppServiceLogs))]

elements.name: aNote
elements.visible: [or(steps('activity').enableActivityPolicy, or(steps('activity').enableKeyVaultLogs, steps('activity').enableNsgLogs, steps('activity').enableFirewallLogs, steps('activity').enableAppGatewayLogs, steps('activity').enableAksLogs, steps('activity').enableAppServiceLogs))]

options.text: Deploys DeployIfNotExists policies at the management group, so they cover every subscription under it, including new ones. Existing resources are fixed by remediation tasks (tick the box below for resource logs; for Azure Activity run: az policy remediation create -n activity-fix --management-group <id> --policy-assignment sentinel-activity-logs). If the core template already enabled Azure Activity for a subscription in this group, delete its sentinel-activity-logs diagnostic setting to avoid duplicate ingestion. For individual subscriptions, use the core template.
Resource log policies for the whole management group (all log categories are sent, which can be costly for NSGs and Firewalls).

elements.name: remediateExistingResources
elements.label: Fix existing resources now (creates remediation tasks)

outputs.managementGroupId: [if(or(steps('activity').enableActivityPolicy, or(steps('activity').enableKeyVaultLogs, steps('activity').enableNsgLogs, steps('activity').enableFirewallLogs, steps('activity').enableAppGatewayLogs, steps('activity').enableAksLogs, steps('activity').enableAppServiceLogs)), steps('activity').managementGroupId, '')]
outputs.remediateExistingResources: [if(or(steps('activity').enableKeyVaultLogs, steps('activity').enableNsgLogs, steps('activity').enableFirewallLogs, steps('activity').enableAppGatewayLogs, steps('activity').enableAksLogs, steps('activity').enableAppServiceLogs), steps('activity').remediateExistingResources, false)]
